implementation.scope: network-free classic-ZIP parsing, scoped member selection, deterministic range coalescing, pre-fetch byte refusal, sparse reconstruction, create-only extraction and per-member CRC/SHA verification

controls: reject split, multi-disk and ZIP64 archives outside the frozen parser scope
reject absolute, traversal, backslash, duplicate, encrypted, symbolic-link and unsupported-compression members
bind the member table to the exact central-directory bytes
require named METADATA and rights members before a member-fetch plan is accepted
require every referenced asset to exist in the directory
merge the smallest range gaps deterministically and count all fetched gap bytes
refuse when prior plus planned response bodies exceed the supplied immutable ceiling
mark a publisher whole-wheel digest declared and unverified for a partial archive
retain the sparse archive and partial extraction when compressed data is corrupt
